checkedAlternates.risk: Sgraffito is carved into leather-hard clay before bisque firing.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Sgraffito is a surface decorative technique applied over slip (group-4), whereas wheel throwing and coil/slab building construct the vessel form (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Wedging is performed by hand on wet clay right before throwing.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Wedging prepares and homogenizes raw clay by removing air bubbles (group-1) prior to shaping the vessel (group-2).
